- Base: $210,000

Thanks — reviewed manager proposal and candidate comp details. I attached a quick model (comp_model_kai_lin.xlsx) and flagged three scenarios:

1) Standard IC4 band (no exception): Base $195k–$215k, OTE midpoint ~$228k, equity 0.10%–0.18%
2) Manager request (base $210k): within band midpoint — approvable without exception if total comp remains within band and equity is 0.15%
3) +10% exception (base up to $231k): I can provisionally approve a one-time +10% above band for base if we add a stronger sign-on and justify against retention risk (candidate has a strong counter). Need Marissa (HR) approval for exception and sign-on cadence.

Rationale: candidate is higher market value for FW kernel/serving expertise; we are within reason for a senior IC4 hire in Bay Area market. Please confirm final ask (exact base, sign-on preference, relocation) and I'll route for final sign-off.

Attachments: comp_model_kai_lin.xlsx
Shared notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-kai-lin-debrief
